bibliographic.title: the beating of my heart
bibliographic.author: eckardlise
bibliographic.description:
Molly wants to leave you. And you want to know why.

Then she tells you...

A satiric anti-love Interactive Fiction story written for the anti-love jam 2023, complete with all the clichés of the Romance genre. There are 6 individual stories, but only one ending.

I used ChatGTP for 42 pages of research on romantic clichés and expressions, and some content. The story idea and all six plots are 100% mine. The story was written in Twine.
